cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: What Was the Plan?
cards.instruction: Find out what was promised, scheduled, or changed without revealing that you lost track.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No need to put me in charge. What time did we settle on for Mum's birthday dinner? I'm checking the invitations.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Seven, in the private room. You booked it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm merely helping this reach the right outcome. Right. How have you written the restaurant name? I want everything consistent.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I haven't written anything. You're doing the invitations.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then could you proofread the booking confirmation aloud? I'll type straight from you so we don't introduce any errors.
